build_model: build an alpha-zero neural network model for a pyspiel game with configurable api version and model type
solve_game: solve a game state recursively using minimax to compute optimal values and store solved states
test_model_learns_simple: test that an alpha-zero model learns a simple policy on tic_tac_toe within loss thresholds
test_model_learns_optimal: test that an alpha-zero model learns optimal play on tic_tac_toe using precomputed solved states
test_conversions: test converting a model between flax linen and nnx api versions while preserving inference behavior
